 a.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):v for i,v in enumerate(c)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(c))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes' if x['item_id']!='k11dc1ef9da' else 'no',note=''))
assert len(a)==len(r)
for x,y in zip(r,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(x['slots'])}
 assert set(y['slots'])==expected
 assert set(y['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ('ъ','ь','other','u') for v in y['slots'].values())
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for y in a:f.write(json.dumps(y,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
